pages.title: Merit Sources
pages.text: This entry documents text material tianyuan_merit_economy.json through the existing Tianyuan worldpack region, Spirit Realm portal rules, and Patchouli guide. The source lists wild-land hunts, beast-wave defense, merit convoy escort, and demon embassy work as major merit sources.

pages.title: Exchange Catalog
pages.text: The design catalog includes high-grade spirit stones, pressure-resistance charms, Diyuan permits, and Wind Feather Raft tickets. The Diyuan permit costs 1200 merit and expects Void Refinement as the minimum realm. The current mod now uses alliance_merit_token as the item currency for the first Tianyuan Merit Exchange.

pages.title: Current Scope
pages.text: The playable prerequisite surface is Tianyuan, its dimension anchor, the Spirit Gathering Array portal rule, Wind Feather Raft Ticket travel, Diyuan Permit entry, and a ShopService item-currency exchange: high-grade spirit stone for 50 tokens, pressure-resist charm for 200, raft ticket for 300, and Diyuan permit for 1200. Purchases stay server-validated.

pages.title: Next Work
pages.text: The full Tianyuan merit system still needs server-authoritative alliance merit accounts, merit missions, exchange UI, monthly and realm gates, Diyuan quest checks, and NPC services. The corresponding native routes are projected in the FTB Quests chapter 'Spirit Realm: Tianyuan and the Fengyuan Clans'; native progress remains authoritative. This is only the first item-currency exchange entry point.
